definitions.explanation: The act of staying somewhere overnight, typically at a hotel or inn.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}で{一泊|いっぱく}{宿泊|しゅくはく}した。
examples.english: I stayed one night in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {宿泊|しゅくはく}{料金|りょうきん}は{朝食|ちょうしょく}{込|こ}みで8,000{円|えん}だ。
examples.english: The accommodation fee is 8,000 yen including breakfast.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}サイトで{宿泊|しゅくはく}{先|さき}を{探|さが}している。{口|くち}コミの{評価|ひょうか}が{高|たか}いところを{選|えら}びたい。
examples.english: I'm looking for accommodations on a travel website. I want to choose a place with high review ratings.

notes:
{宿泊|しゅくはく} refers to lodging or staying overnight at a hotel, inn, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}する (to stay overnight, to lodge)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}を{予約|よやく}する (to book accommodation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}{料金|りょうきん} / {宿泊|しゅくはく}{費|ひ} (accommodation fee)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}{施設|しせつ} (lodging facility)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}{先|さき} (place to stay)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}{客|きゃく} (hotel guest)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}{予約|よやく} (accommodation reservation)
- {素泊|すどま}り{宿泊|しゅくはく} (room only, no meals)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}: lodging (formal term)
- {泊|と}まる: to stay (casual verb)
- {宿|やど}: lodging, inn (traditional word)
